content: Hi, this is Spark from Smart Chip Tree. We provide employee ID card and RFID solutions, and we're currently offering free on-site service for ID card printers, card designing and software. Could I have just a brief moment of your time?
I’m calling from Smart Chip Tree – offices in Delhi, Noida, Bangalore and Pune, HQ in Delhi.

Yes, we offer a range of ID card printers including models from Zebra, Evolis, HID Fargo, DataCard and IDP retransfer printers. Would you like me to connect you with a specialist who can discuss your specific requirements for these printers?

Certainly. If you’re utilizing printers like the Zebra, HID Fargo, DataCard or IDP retransfer systems, we offer wholesale rates on printer ribbons. Would you like me to connect you with a specialist who can discuss ribbon options and pricing for your application?
Great. May I get your name?
Thanks. And which organization are you calling from?
Got it. What time would you prefer for the callback?
Perfect, xyz, our specialist will contact you at around 7 pm. Thank you for your time, have a great day!
